title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Anna went on a trip to the mountains. She wanted an adventure, so she went hiking with her friend Tom. They walked for six hours and saw a big lake. The water was very clear and blue.

In the evening, they stayed in a small house near the lake. They cooked soup and talked about their day. Anna said it was the best trip of her life. Tom said he wanted to go back next year.

questions.text: What did Anna and Tom do in the mountains?
Where did they stay in the evening?
options: In a small house near the lake
In a hotel in the city
In a tent on the mountain
On a boat on the water

questions.text: How did Anna feel about the trip?
options: She was very happy with it

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom?
options: He wants to visit the mountains again
He wants to move to the city

vocabulary.definition: walking for a long time in the countryside
a hot liquid food made with vegetables or meat

paragraph_translations: W zeszłe lato Anna pojechała na wycieczkę w góry. Chciała przygody, więc poszła na wędrówkę z przyjacielem Tomem. Szli sześć godzin i zobaczyli duże jezioro. Woda była bardzo przejrzysta i niebieska.
Wieczorem zatrzymali się w małym domu blisko jeziora. Ugotowali zupę i rozmawiali o swoim dniu. Anna powiedziała, że to najlepsza wycieczka w jej życiu. Tom powiedział, że chce wrócić za rok.
